description: Full SDR development and analysis environment with GNU Radio 3.10, 30+ OOT modules, SDR drivers, GUI apps (GQRX, SDR++, SDRAngel, CubicSDR, SatDump, SigDigger), decoders, and cellular tools.
notes:
Based on kasmweb/core-ubuntu-noble:1.17.0. Includes SDR drivers (RTL-SDR, HackRF, Airspy, LimeSDR, PlutoSDR, UHD, SoapySDR), GNU Radio 3.10, GUI apps, decoders (rtl_433, dump1090, dumpvdl2, dumphfdl, acarsdec, multimon-ng), cellular (srsRAN 4G/5G, LTESniffer, FALCON), and trunking tools.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.
